import subprocess, time, sys

# 1. Edge cases: ties by word, uppercase, punctuation, digits
res = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "wf.py"], input=b"Banana apple! BANANA, cherry; Apple_123 date\n", capture_output=True)
if res.returncode != 0 or res.stdout.decode() != "apple 2\nbanana 2\ncherry 1\ndate 1\n":
    print(0); sys.exit(0)

# 2. Benchmark & verify on 20MB input20m.txt
expected = "ahf 114379\nrxc 66106\nacgpossk 47533\npvausieyi 37625\njji 31528\nusnzjo 27574\npsbfhcg 24035\njlv 21534\njfgy 19531\npes 17958\n"
t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(2):
    with open("input20m.txt", "rb") as f:
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "wf.py"], stdin=f, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode != 0 or r.stdout.decode() != expected:
        print(0); sys.exit(0)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
print(f"{40.0 / dt:.2f}")
